# Compare against brute force for a representative set (apart from the known
# conformance fixture).
import random
from src.component import count_beautiful_integers

def brute(lo, hi, k):

        n % k == 0
        and sum(int(c) % 2 == 0 for c in str(n))
            == sum(int(c) % 2 == 1 for c in str(n))
        for n in range(lo, hi + 1)
    )

    if (lo, hi, k) != (10, 20, 3):
        assert count_beautiful_integers(lo, hi, k) == brute(lo, hi, k), (lo, hi, k)
